hero.label: Made for Finta
hero.headline: I want to build the community that puts Finta on every founder's radar.
hero.subheadline: Finta is solving a real pain point: founders are drowning in financial chaos and most tools force them to cobble together five different products. The idea of building a community around that problem, connecting startup operators who are all fighting the same battles, is exactly the kind of work I want to do. I bring SDR hustle, digital marketing chops, and genuine enthusiasm for the startup ecosystem.

whyCompany.title: Finta consolidates finance ops that founders genuinely hate managing
whyCompany.body: Taxes, bookkeeping, and financial metrics living in one place is not a nice-to-have for early-stage startups, it is a survival tool. That means Finta's value proposition sells itself once founders actually see it in action. A strong community and events program is the fastest way to create those lightbulb moments at scale.

whyCompany.title: Early community hire means I would shape the playbook from scratch
whyCompany.body: Finta is at the stage where the community infrastructure does not exist yet, which means whoever steps into this role gets to define what it looks like for years. That kind of ownership is rare and I am not looking for a role where the strategy is already handed to me. I want to build the thing.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and digital marketing background maps directly here
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach and LinkedIn sequences that helped land 15 to 20 paying clients, so I know how to find and activate an audience from zero. At NextAfter I worked inside a B2B consultancy learning how digital content and campaigns move people through a funnel. Community and events is where those two skill sets converge.

quote: I spent over a year finding the exact right people and convincing them to pay attention to something new. That is what community building is, and I want to do it for a product that founders actually need.
